detail.longDescription: typing.reveal_type() notes that: Most type checkers support reveal_type() anywhere, even if the name is not imported from typing . [...] But the same isn't true for typing.assert_type() and typing.assert_never . For example, with Pyright: reveal_type assert_type # Error: "assert_type" is not defined assert_never # Error: "assert_never" is not defined Why don't type checkers support these two names without import?
